scientific_integrity: Universal result follows from a full integer potential transition inequality and a separate all-large-state bound. Finite checker tests all small states, complete short horizons and a sharp family; no finite test is treated as proof of all horizons.
scientific_limitations: Two agents; identical additive strictly positive values in {u,2u,3u}; fixed item order; multiplicative cumulative maximum envy only. No general unrestricted-valuations guarantee. Primary related paper inspected through public abstract and secondary scholarly summary, not original full text; equivalent unindexed or buried theorem remains a priority risk.
title: Sharp \(5/3\) cumulative-envy guarantee for three-value greedy allocation
